# `deposits.term_deposit.InterestPaid`

Interest is paid out — the coarse coupon/advance payout fact (the periodic/coupon variant, vs the single AT_MATURITY flow): NetInterest = GrossInterest − WithholdingTax conserved to the cent. PROMOTED to an integration event per [ADR-IC-017](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-017-integration-event-promotion-criterion.md) §P4 (coarse business fact; GL/accounting, notifications, and reporting react to it). The integration-relevant withholding AMOUNT rides here on withholding_tax_cents — the fine-grained WithholdingApplied/InterestAccrued accrual mechanics stay internal/store-only. Business payload only ([ADR-IC-002](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md) §P5); CloudEvents envelope rides in Kafka headers, NOT here. No PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2): deposit_id is an opaque reference, never depositor identity.

## Payload fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `deposit_id` | `string` (`uuid`) | DepositId (Guid) — an opaque aggregate reference, NOT depositor identity ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2). |
| `gross_interest_cents` | `long` | GrossInterest as integer EUR cents (Money.Cents, [ADR-PC-010](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-010-dotnet-hand-rolled-engine.md) §P1). |
| `withholding_tax_cents` | `long` | WithholdingTax as integer EUR cents (Money.Cents) — the integration-relevant withholding amount carried on this coarse payout fact, so a separate WithholdingApplied integration event is redundant ([ADR-IC-017](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-017-integration-event-promotion-criterion.md) §P4). |
| `net_interest_cents` | `long` | NetInterest = GrossInterest − WithholdingTax as integer EUR cents (Money.Cents), conserved to the cent. |
| `paid_on` | `int` (`date`) | PaidOn (DateOnly) as days since epoch. |
| `movements` | `array<`record`>` | The coupon/advance-interest payout's money movement(s) recorded append-first ([ADR-PC-032](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-032-money-movement-primitive.md) slot 5; bd t7o3.13). A REQUIRED array (an event with no movements carries an EMPTY array, never null) defaulted to [] so pre-Movement records still decode (forward-only schema evolution, [ADR-IC-002](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md) §P3 / BACKWARD compat). The engine's family-agnostic codec (MovementCarrier) binds this to InterestPaid's IReadOnlyList<Movement>; the promoted ce_movementorigin / ce_movementdirections headers auto-start the substrate settlement saga. |

[ADR-IC-002](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md), [ADR-IC-017](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-017-integration-event-promotion-criterion.md), [ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md), [ADR-PC-010](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-010-dotnet-hand-rolled-engine.md), [ADR-PC-032](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-032-money-movement-primitive.md)
